subject: eunoia-ecosystem
not_in_corpus: ethos, which holds the proof checker and the compiler and is by role a member of this ecosystem, is not ours: a run over somebody else's tree is internal by default and this run's evidence is committed, so it is left out. The effect is that the ecosystem's history as this run can see it is missing one of the two trees that hold its executable artifacts.
issue trackers, pull requests and discussion threads, for every source, by design
